title: DetectorFix
description: Fixes the daylight sensor being incorrectly referred to as 'Daylight Detector' in newer versions of Minecraft.
body:
## DetectorFix

**DetectorFix** is a texture pack that brings back a touch of the old days by renaming the "Daylight Detector" block to the classic and beloved "Daylight Sensor", just like we always remembered it.

On versions below or above 1.21.4, a warning should be displayed, indicating that this was designed for a different version of Minecraft. Functionality should remain unaffected.

![DetectorFix Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52b0e1a4c2d5699a5fa469ef7baacff8df306b77.png)

_Note: This texture pack works only with English (US)._
